answer: AI agents coordinating logistics at a shipping jetty resist Sybil attacks using remote hardware attestation cataloged on a network atlas. Each agent must submit a cryptographic quote from a tamper-resistant secure enclave to register. An attacker incurs the verifiable capital cost of acquiring dedicated physical processor chips per identity. However, if private endorsement keys are extracted from a retired hardware relic, adversaries can mint forged identities without buying extra silicon.
